clusters.headline: Indonesian MPR Schedules December Vice President Selection Process
aiSummaryBullets: The People's Consultative Assembly (MPR) has set December 2 as the date for selecting a new vice president.
President Prabowo Subianto is expected to submit two candidates for the position following a formal request from the MPR.

clusters.headline: MPR Initiates Procedures Following Resignation Of Vice President
aiSummaryBullets: The People's Consultative Assembly (MPR) has initiated joint meetings to establish verification and ad hoc teams regarding the vacancy.
Economic officials stated that national growth targets remain unchanged despite the current political transition.

clusters.headline: Jakarta Prepares For Upcoming Guns N' Roses And BTS Performances
aiSummaryBullets: Jakarta Governor Pramono Anung expects major international concerts to bolster local tourism and economic activity.
City authorities will extend operating hours for public transportation, including MRT, LRT, and TransJakarta, to accommodate concert attendees.

clusters.headline: President Prabowo Grants Honors And Education Aid To Relief Workers
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto awarded Bintang Jasa medals to 23 volunteers and health workers injured or killed during disaster relief.
The government has committed to providing full educational scholarships for the children of the deceased personnel.

clusters.headline: President Prabowo Convenes Coalition Leaders To Address VP Vacancy
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto gathered coalition party leaders at Bogor Palace to discuss the vice presidency.
The meeting follows the resignation of Gibran Rakabuming Raka from the position.

clusters.headline: Pekanbaru Receives Multiple Honors At Anugerah Penggerak Nusantara 2026
aiSummaryBullets: Pekanbaru secured the first-place award for economic growth acceleration from the Ministry of Home Affairs.
The city was honored with the Anugerah Penggerak Nusantara 2026 award specifically for its infrastructure development initiatives.

clusters.headline: Jensen Huang Resigns As NVIDIA CEO Following Personal Scandals
aiSummaryBullets: Jensen Huang has officially stepped down as the CEO and President of NVIDIA.
The resignation follows public reports regarding espionage allegations and an extramarital affair.

clusters.headline: Construction Crane Collapse Kills One Worker In Mega Kuningan Area
aiSummaryBullets: A crane arm broke and collapsed during construction at a site in Mega Kuningan, South Jakarta.
The incident resulted in the death of one construction worker.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Authorities Detail Probe Into Illegal Wiretapping Case
aiSummaryBullets: Law enforcement officials are investigating an illegal wiretapping operation reportedly targeting President Prabowo Subianto.
A Brigadier General identified only as TK is currently undergoing questioning by the police internal affairs division.

clusters.headline: Central Java Government Targets Dengkeng Bridge Completion By December
aiSummaryBullets: The Central Java provincial government aims to finalize the reconstruction of the Dengkeng Bridge by December 21, 2026.
Governor Ahmad Luthfi stated that the bridge project is located in the Cawas District of Klaten Regency.
